correctness.rationale: Weighted matrix-tree theorem gives det of grounded reduced Laplacian. Injectivity of weighted tree-cone matrix map and logdet strict concavity prove a unique optimizer. Gaussian AR(1) innovation construction on a tree proves exact covariance, determinant and sparse inverse. Substitution gives all weights and exact budget; all KKT derivatives equal the budget dual multiplier on active edges, including threshold zero spokes. When cost >=2 the spoke-only solution satisfies unused-edge KKT inequalities. For lower prices, assuming all spokes active forces all tree edges active, then the unique covariance tree-Markov factorization yields a negative impossible maximum-degree spoke. Exact-rational and numerical checker corroborates, not replaces, the proof.

value.rationale: A natural joint continuous-cost D-optimal spanning-tree design on cones over all finite trees has an explicit exact optimum and a sharp degree-controlled support transition over a meaningful price interval, plus a global support classification at lower cost. Topology-independent optimal determinant and exact zero-weight predictions guide graph-resource design; this extends genuinely beyond earlier solved terminal-path subcases. No unsupported full low-price allocation or downstream application is claimed.
